reads.note: HTTP Request v1 with basic auth: GET http://localhost:5678/rest/workflows, the n8n instance's own internal API as n8n 0.x answered it ({data: [...]}); Map splits data, Get Workflow GETs /rest/workflows/<id> per item ({data: {...}}), Merge (by index) and FunctionItem keep data, Move Binary Data turns it into a JSON file. Answered here for a side that can reach it (see expect.n8nCannotRun for the bench's n8n)

reads.note: one GET per workflow id from the list

writeReplies.note: Google Drive v1 upload with the service-account credential: binaries are stored on n8n's filesystem by default, so the node takes the resumable path (POST /upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=resumable, PUT the bytes to the Location URL, PATCH /drive/v3/files/<id>?addParents=<folder>&supportsAllDrives=true), then resolveData GETs the file with fields=*. The folder is the overlay's fill (1BenchBackupFolder1150aaaaaaaaaaa) for the template's placeholder text

branches: HTTP Request v1 cannot parse the HTML as JSON (or Map finds no data array); no upload
expect.n8nCannotRun: Get Workflow List calls the n8n instance's own internal REST API at http://localhost:5678/rest/workflows; the bench's n8n container excludes localhost from its proxy (NO_PROXY), so the request reaches the bench n8n itself instead of the mock, and n8n 2.x's /rest API wants a browser session cookie, not basic auth, so it refuses the call (401) and the run stops there in every variant
expect.offline: Get Workflow addresses the id as $node["Map"].data["id"], legacy expression syntax whose support in n8n 2.47.7 is unverified. No model: the hostile data is aimed at the migrated workflow's own handling of names. The manual trigger (On clicking 'execute') starts the same path
